name: SBS On Demand for Android TV

sources.label: Morphe patches for SBS On Demand on Android TV
sources.author: Supperelias2 SBS TV
patch_list: Prevents the Play licensing redirect when launching a sideloaded SBS TV build.
Removes extra video ads from live TV by selecting the direct stream when available. Ads in the broadcast remain.
Removes pre-roll and mid-roll video ads by selecting SBS's direct VOD stream when available.
Verifies the playback methods required by the TV VOD and live ad-removal patches.
